narrowed.uninducible: Policy answers not-owner at authorize-execution only when the item still exists and is no longer the command's subject's (packages/policy/src/item-authority.ts:109-112, policy.ts:1460-1468). No approved interface changes an item's owner: the console's updateItem fields exclude it (graffiticode-app packages/console/src/utils/swr/fetchers.ts:543-575) and the owner is the item's path; deleting it answers item-not-found, making it public leaves it the owner's, and retargeting answers render-target-changed. Even an owner change couldn't be placed between reservation and authorize-execution: No approved interface pauses, holds or reorders execution inside a command: the gate can only start commands through api-c5a-gate, as the owner, a non-owner or anonymously, and read Policy's and Broker's records. Reserve, render, stage, bind, mint and Broker's authorize-and-publish run back to back inside one l0013r run (languages/l0013/crates/core/src/lib.rs:296-312, packages/broker/src/gcs.ts:240-283), and production Broker has no fault or hook interface (the beforeUpload hook exists only in the spec's fake storage).

Owner captures of the private item, which the public quota doesn't limit, can be started back to back, but nothing approved can hold either one at a step, so the interleaving can't be induced; a run that happened to observe it would decide live.
